stories.title: ‘I miss old Google’: readers tell us how they search the internet in the age of AI
stories.summary: Google’s AI Overviews now place an AI-generated summary ahead of the traditional list of links, changing how users encounter search results. The Guardian reports that the feature is shifting the browsing habits of billions of people and prompting some readers to say they miss the older Google experience.

links.headline: ‘I miss old Google’: readers tell us how they search the internet in the age of AI
links.excerpt: A feature called AI Overviews has been a profound change, and the browsing habits of billions of people are shifting Google has put artificial intelligence at the front and center of its search bar. The most-visited site on the internet still shows the same list of links to users, but they have to scroll past a summarized response from an AI chatbot, a feature Google calls AI Overviews. stories.title: SpaceX launches crew to ISS successfully: ‘Thanks for an amazing ride’
stories.summary: SpaceX launched four astronauts toward the International Space Station on Thursday for a mission expected to last until spring after a three-week delay. Commander Jessica Watkins, the first Black woman to lead a crew to orbit, is making her second trip to the station; the crew also includes a Canadian astronaut whose wife is due to give birth while he is away.

links.headline: SpaceX launches crew to ISS successfully: ‘Thanks for an amazing ride’
